title: Asymptotic behavior analysis of solutions to the Heisenberg ferromagnet equation with the Schwartz initial data
summary: This work aims to investigate the long-time asymptotic behavior of solutions to the Cauchy problem for the Heisenberg ferromagnet equation with the Schwartz initial data. Utilizing the gauge transformations, spectral analysis and the inverse scattering method, we prove that the solutions to the Heisenberg ferromagnet equation can be expressed in terms of the solutions to a matrix Riemann-Hilbert problem formulated in the complex $k$-plane.
